corrections.text: The article quotes the AWS News Blog as saying AWS now provides "consistent connectivity experiences across Microsoft Azure (Preview), OCI (Generally Available), and Google Cloud (Generally Available)." The blog post's actual wording is: "This allows AWS to provide a consistent, simple experience to our customers on Microsoft Azure (Preview), OCI (Generally Available), and Google Cloud (Generally Available)." The parenthetical status labels are accurate; the surrounding phrase was paraphrased rather than quoted verbatim.
